title: Statements for 25 orders and their line items
method: Synthetic fixture: 25 orders × 4 line items. Lazy strategy uses 1 + 25 statements; one compatible select-in batch uses 2; join uses 1 and returns 100 joined rows. Assumes no extra loads or batch splitting. Fewer statements need not mean lower latency.
alt: Statements for 25 orders and their line items. Lazy collection loading: 26 SQL statements; One select-in batch: 2 SQL statements; Joined loading: 1 SQL statements. Illustrative inputs.
